_comment: TEMPLATE — copy the shape into servers.json (or a servers.local.json override) for YOUR deployment. One entry per machine. Rules of thumb: (1) 'name' is a STABLE resolvable name — mDNS .local on a single LAN, or a real DNS name; consumers resolve it to the current IP at startup/reconcile, which is what makes DHCP drift a non-event. (2) 'aliases' are the conventional service names other config refers to (afl-mongodb, afl-minio, ...) — they map to this machine without /etc/hosts entries. (3) exactly one entry should have 'infra': true — the machine running MongoDB/MinIO/dashboard; tools use it as the default infra target. (4) 'ip_pin' is a LAST RESORT for hosts that name resolution cannot reach (cross-subnet, no mDNS): a pinned IP goes stale when the lease changes, which is the failure this catalog removes — leave it null if you can. 'group' is the FW_SERVER_GROUP role tag used by server-groups gating (docs/architecture/server-groups.md).

servers.name: infra-host.local
servers.purpose: infra: MongoDB, MinIO, dashboard, image registry

servers.name: big-workstation.local
servers.purpose: heavy runner tier (large imports, wide fan-outs)

servers.name: 10.20.30.40-cross-subnet-box
servers.purpose: example of a host mDNS cannot reach — pin its address
